summary: Fix joinURL so path segments go before the query and hash, with tests. The fix and tests are in place on a branch the owner is pushing, but no merge or release is recorded.
narrative: On 2026-11-03 the owner reported that joinURL("/api?v=2", "users") returned "/api?v=2/users" and should return "/api/users?v=2", with the same rule for a #hash. The agent traced the cause to string concatenation without parsing (obs 5) and checked the existing helpers (obs 6). It patched joinURL to split off the base query and fragment before appending segments, and added regression tests. Those tests showed joinRelativeURL has the same defect (obs 7). The agent then moved the query and hash cases into a joinURL-only loop so joinRelativeURL no longer inherits them. A full run showed 46 failing tests, concentrated in the unimplemented isSameOrigin tests (obs 8). The owner said they were pushing the branch for the joinURL fix and told the agent not to touch the same-origin tests. No PR, merge or release is recorded. The joinRelativeURL defect is still open.

milestones.text: Owner reported joinURL putting segments after the query/hash and asked for a fix with tests.
Root cause found: joinURL concatenates strings without parsing.
joinURL patched to keep the base query and fragment at the end. New tests showed joinRelativeURL fails the same cases.
Join query/hash cases moved to a joinURL-only loop. The full suite showed 46 failures, mostly the unimplemented isSameOrigin tests.
Owner said they are pushing the branch for the joinURL fix and told the agent to leave the same-origin tests alone.

preferences.preference: Keep unrelated work out of a branch being pushed; leave the other tests untouched until that feature is implemented.
preferences.quote: Don't touch the same-origin tests right now, I'm pushing this branch for the joinURL fix; we'll sort them out when we implement it.
